title: Redundant duplicate fallback arms in ApiReturnedLeaderboard guard
detail: The Error-with-mismatched-tag arm and the catch-all arm have identical bodies; the catch-all alone covers both cases. Dead branch adds noise to the guard's decision table.
recommended_fix: Drop the `Error(_err), _ ->` arm; the trailing `_, _ -> #(model, effect.none())` already covers it.
